BETA Close X Ninety One plc has repurchased a total of 1,978,830 ordinary shares between June 15 and June 19, 2026, for a total cost of £4,299,167.56. The purchases were executed through J.P. Morgan Securities plc as part of the company's ongoing share buyback program, with the lowest price paid per share being 211.6000 GBp and the highest at 220.0000 GBp. Following these transactions, the company holds no shares in treasury, and its total issued ordinary shares now stand at 666,693,570.
